name: The villa
concept: Warm contemporary: travertine, limewashed walls, oak and walnut, linen and brushed brass. Calm and low, so the light does the work.
brief: Warm contemporary scheme for a new-build villa in Dubai: travertine and limewash, oak and walnut, linen, brushed brass, low furniture, warm lighting. Keep every wall, door, window, stair and built-in exactly where it is.

spaces.title: Front garden and entrance
spaces.note: Sand and drip lines become a planted front garden: olive trees, ornamental grasses, a travertine path and warm wall lights.
spaces.prompt: Landscape this front garden: travertine stepping path, gravel beds, olive trees and ornamental grasses, low warm uplights, a planted border along the wall. Keep the house, its walls, gates, openings and paving exactly as they are. Outdoor daylight photograph.

spaces.title: Back garden
spaces.note: An empty sand plot turned into a garden to live in: a lawn, a shaded seating terrace and a strip of planting along each wall.
spaces.prompt: Landscape this back garden: a lawn, a travertine terrace by the glass doors with an outdoor sofa set and a slatted pergola, olive trees and grasses in planted beds along the boundary walls, a dining table for six. Keep the house, its walls, doors, windows and the boundary walls exactly as they are. Outdoor daylight photograph.

spaces.title: Balconies
spaces.note: Bare tiled balconies get a pair of lounge chairs, a small table, planters and an outdoor rug.
spaces.prompt: Furnish this balcony: two low teak lounge chairs, a small round side table, an outdoor rug, two tall planters with olive trees. Keep the railing, slats, walls, ceiling and the view exactly as they are.

spaces.title: Living and dining
spaces.note: One long room, zoned: a low linen sofa and travertine table by the glass, a walnut table for eight under a single pendant.
spaces.prompt: Furnish this open living and dining room as one scheme: a low linen sofa and two lounge chairs around a travertine coffee table on a large wool rug near the glass doors, a walnut dining table for eight with a linen pendant above it, a long low sideboard, limewashed feature wall, sheer linen curtains, floor and table lamps.

spaces.title: Kitchen
spaces.note: The kitchen stays as built. It gains warm under-cabinet light, two pendants, stools and a few things on the counter.
spaces.prompt: Keep every cabinet, worktop, appliance opening and window exactly as built. Add warm under-cabinet lighting, two brushed-brass pendants, a runner rug, a wooden board, a bowl of lemons and a few ceramics on the counter.

spaces.title: Entrance hall and stairs
spaces.note: A slim console, a round mirror and a runner by the door; a framed print and soft wall light up the stairs.
spaces.prompt: Dress this hall and stair: a slim walnut console with a round brass mirror above it, a runner rug, a ceramic lamp, framed art up the stair wall, warm wall lights. Keep the stair, its treads and handrail, and every door completely clear and unchanged.

spaces.title: Maid's room and laundry
spaces.note: A small room made restful: a single bed, a slim wardrobe and a reading light; the laundry gets shelves and baskets.
spaces.prompt: Furnish this small room simply: a single bed with linen bedding, a bedside table and lamp, a slim wardrobe, a small rug, a framed print. If it is a laundry cupboard, fit open shelves, woven baskets and a hanging rail instead.

spaces.title: Main bedroom
spaces.note: An upholstered bed facing the balcony, walnut bedside tables, a reading chair and full-height linen curtains.
spaces.prompt: Furnish this main bedroom: a king bed with an upholstered headboard and linen bedding, walnut bedside tables with ceramic lamps, a reading chair and side table by the glass doors, a large wool rug, full-height sheer linen curtains, a limewashed or panelled wall behind the bed. Keep the built-in wardrobes as they are.

spaces.title: Bedrooms
spaces.note: Three more bedrooms on the same scheme, each with its own colour: sage, clay and sand.
spaces.prompt: Furnish this bedroom: a queen bed with linen bedding, bedside tables and lamps, a desk and chair by the window, a wool rug, linen curtains, framed art, a soft colour on the wall behind the bed. Keep the built-in wardrobes as they are.

spaces.title: Bathrooms
spaces.note: The tiles, basins and glass stay. Warmer light, linen towels, a teak stool, plants and a few good things on the counter.
spaces.prompt: Keep every tile, basin, toilet, shower screen, bath, mirror and window exactly as built. Add warm lighting, folded linen towels, a teak stool or bath tray, a small plant, a ceramic soap dish and a candle.

spaces.title: Garage
spaces.note: A storage wall along one side and a small home-gym corner, with the doors left clear.
spaces.prompt: Fit out this garage: a wall of closed storage cabinets along one side, a home-gym corner with a rubber floor mat, a bench and a rack of dumbbells, bright even ceiling light. Keep the doors, openings and floor drains clear and unchanged.
